t.1336-21-6.agn: The Turkish Ministry of Health advises against mixing it with bleach; mixing produces chloramine gases that irritate the airways.
t.1336-21-6.pw.0: Its smell and vapour can irritate the airways; use with ventilation.
t.1336-21-6.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 007-001-01-2 (CLP00): Skin Corr. 1B, Aquatic Acute 1.
t.1336-21-6.summary: Ammonia dissolved in water; a base (alkali).
t.1336-21-6.what: Dissolves grease and dirt and evaporates without leaving streaks.
